description: BPSC TRE Computer Science Model Test Paper 05 (English Medium) containing 120 questions across General Studies and Computer Science.

questions.questionText: How many three-digit numbers are divisible by 5?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Pahli 3-digit sankhya 100 hai aur aakhiri 995 hai. Total terms = ((995 - 100) / 5) + 1 = 180.

questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: (3/2) * (4/3) * (5/4) * ... * (121/120) me sabhi beech ke terms cancel ho jaate hain, bachta hai 121 / 2 = 60.5.

questions.questionText: If 12 men or 18 women can reap a field in 14 days, then in how many days can 8 men and 16 women reap the same field?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 12 men = 18 women => 1 man = 1.5 women. 8 men + 16 women = 8 * 1.5 + 16 = 28 women. Days = (18 * 14) / 28 = 9 days.

questions.questionText: A vessel contains 60 liters of milk. 12 liters of milk is taken out and replaced by water. This process is repeated once more. How much milk is now contained by the vessel?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above

questions.questionText: The average of four consecutive even numbers is 27. What is the largest of these numbers?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Sankhyayein x, x+2, x+4, x+6 hain. Inka average x + 3 = 27 => x = 24. Sabse badi sankhya = 24 + 6 = 30.

questions.questionText: A train 150 meters long passes a telegraph pole in 12 seconds. In what time will it pass a bridge 250 meters long?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Speed = 150 / 12 = 12.5 m/s. Bridge ko paar karne me total distance = 150 + 250 = 400 m. Time = 400 / 12.5 = 32 seconds.

questions.questionText: The perimeter of a rectangle is 82 meters and its area is 400 square meters. What is the length of its diagonal?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 2(l + b) = 82 => l + b = 41. l * b = 400. Diagonal = sqrt(l^2 + b^2) = sqrt((l + b)^2 - 2lb) = sqrt(41^2 - 2*400) = sqrt(1681 - 800) = sqrt(881) ≈ 29.68 (or standard pythagorean pair 25 and 16 gives l+b=41, lb=400, diagonal = sqrt(625 + 256) = sqrt(881) ≈ 29 m).

questions.questionText: If log_10(2) = 0.3010, then what is the number of digits in 2^50?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: log10(2^50) = 50 * 0.3010 = 15.05. Number of digits = Characteristic + 1 = 15 + 1 = 16.

questions.questionText: The phenomenon of dispersion of white light into its component colors through a glass prism occurs because:
questions.optionA: Wavelengths of all light colors travel at the exact same speed in glass
questions.optionB: Different colors of light bend through different angles with respect to the incident ray
questions.optionC: Total internal reflection occurs inside the glass prism
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Kaanch me alag-alag wavelengths ki light ki speed alag hone ke kaaran we alag-alag angles par refract hoti hain.

questions.questionText: Which physical law states that current through a conductor between two points is directly proportional to the voltage across the two points under constant temperature?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Ohm ka niyam batata hai ki sthir tapman par V proportional to I hota hai (V = IR).

questions.explanation: Total luminous flux = 4pi * Luminous Intensity = 4pi * 2 = 8pi lumen[cite: 1].
